baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command اتقوا governs both ما بين أيديكم and ما خلفكم, and ends with the hoped passive ترحمون.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reflexive self-protection takes the whole deictic field: what is immediately ahead and what is behind. Mercy is the hoped protective outcome of responding to that comprehensive exposure.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the passive warning frame that launches the command.
Putting the self into protection supplies the governing action for the whole mechanism.
The interval between sides establishes a surrounding relational field rather than an isolated object.
What is before the hands supplies the near or approaching side of exposure.
What lies behind supplies the complementary rearward side of exposure.
Tender beneficence supplies the hoped result of taking protection.

changed_reading.before: A general command to be pious so that mercy may follow.
changed_reading.after: A call to place the self in protection with respect to the entire field immediately ahead and behind, with mercy as the hoped outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أيديكم can attribute action to the hands, while خلفكم can name what succeeds or remains after a person.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two sides can be causal and temporal: deeds generated by one's agency stand before one, while consequences, successors, or a trailing legacy remain behind. Protection therefore includes responsibility for both production and aftermath.

activation_trace.role: A barrier against harm turns responsibility for deeds and aftermath into preventive action.
Attributing work or offense to the hands makes the forward field an agent's own production.
What comes afterward or stands in another's place supplies the consequential and successor field.
Merciful beneficence gives preventive responsibility a reparative horizon.

changed_reading.before: Guard against dangers located in front of and behind you.
changed_reading.after: Guard against the harm carried by what your agency projects forward and what it leaves trailing after you.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The hand branches include possession and beneficence, while خلف includes those who come after.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command can govern the handling of what is under present control and what will pass to successors. Protection becomes stewardship across transfer rather than self-defense alone.

activation_trace.role: Protective prevention supplies the duty applied to controlled goods and their transfer.
The possessing hand supplies the domain currently under the addressees' disposal.
The beneficent hand makes giving a possible function of present control.
Those who come afterward extend the protected domain beyond the present holder.
Merciful care supplies the social quality expected of stewardship.

changed_reading.before: Protect yourselves from an external surround.
changed_reading.after: Exercise protective care over what is in your hands and over how it reaches those who come after.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact front-and-behind coordinate already appears inside paired dams, a covering, and failed sight. Protection is therefore reversible: a barrier may ward off harm, but a sealed surround can itself prevent perception and response. The following ayah adds active turning-away to the earlier imposed blindness.

activation_trace.role: A protective barrier supplies the ordinary shield model that the context reverses.
A form-distant protective buttress image makes the commanded protection collide with the surrounding dams.
The interval before the hands reproduces the focus ayah's near-side coordinate.
The before-the-hands branch confirms that the repeated wording marks the same forward field.
Closing a gap and partitioning sides turns both coordinates into an enclosing obstruction.
The rearward side completes the same two-sided enclosure found in the focus.
A covering laid over the subject supplies the obstruction's perceptual effect.
Literal sight supplies the faculty disabled by the enclosing barriers.
Turning one's side away makes perceptual closure an enacted response as well as an imposed condition.

structural_cues: 36:9 repeats the focus phrase in the same front-then-behind order and assigns a dam to each side.
36:9 ends in non-seeing, while 36:46 immediately follows the focus with repeated turning-away from signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact coordinate phrase, dams, covering, non-seeing, and later turning-away; I infer that the command warns against the enclosure itself as well as dangers within it. The live alternative is the ordinary all-sided-danger reading.

changed_reading.before: Build or seek protection against dangers on every side.
changed_reading.after: Guard yourselves against becoming enclosed by the very shields, habits, or refusals that make every side unreadable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah pairs what people send ahead with their remaining traces, later attributes production to hands, and finally makes hands testify to earnings. Front and behind thus become a recorded causal topology: projected acts ahead, persistent effects behind, and the agent's own body as evidence.

activation_trace.role: Attribution of deeds to the hands anchors the accountable agency in the focus phrase.
What follows and stands after a person supplies the trailing consequential field.
Advancing something forward supplies the action projected into the agent's future encounter.
A remaining mark supplies the effects that trail behind their originating act.
Work assigned to the hands confirms that hand language can mark personal production.
Intentional work supplies the object of the later recompense scene.
The deed-bearing hands become speakers, converting agency into embodied evidence.
Testimony that declares known facts supplies the evidentiary function of the body.
Acquired gain or liability supplies what the bodily testimony discloses.

structural_cues: 36:12 coordinates what was sent ahead with آثارهم and says everything is enumerated.
36:35 joins عمل with أيديهم, 36:54 limits recompense to عمل, and 36:65 makes أيديهم speak about what was earned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the forward act, lingering trace, hand-work, recompense, and bodily testimony; I map the first pair onto the focus's front and behind. A live alternative is that the focus names spatial dangers while these accountability scenes only illustrate one class of them.

changed_reading.before: Be wary of external threats located around you.
changed_reading.after: Be wary of the accountable field your own acts place before you and the traces they leave operating behind you.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, a laden vessel carries a vulnerable collective, drowning can close over them, no rescuer is available, and mercy alone excepts them while extending use only to a term. Mercy in the focus is therefore not merely a later reward; it is already the bounded rescue that keeps the addressees afloat long enough to respond.

activation_trace.role: Ward against harm supplies the human response to the surrounding drowning risk.
Tender beneficence names the hoped condition that the preceding sequence presents as rescue.
Bearing a visible load supplies the collective's vulnerable transport.
A vessel moving in water supplies the exposed container around the carried group.
Filling the vessel intensifies the dependence of its load on continued preservation.
Drowning in water supplies the concrete harm surrounding the vessel.
Extraction from peril supplies the rescue explicitly denied apart from the following exception.
Merciful beneficence supplies the stated exception to drowning and failed rescue.
Extended preservation supplies the temporary continuation granted by mercy.
An appointed interval bounds the preservation and creates urgency for the command.

structural_cues: The mercy exception in 36:44 stands immediately before وإذا قيل لهم in 36:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies current carriage, possible drowning, absent rescue, mercy as exception, and a bounded interval; I infer that the command addresses people already being preserved, not people awaiting mercy from a neutral position. The live alternative is that 36:44 and 36:45 describe separate instances of mercy.

changed_reading.before: Take protection now so that mercy may be awarded later.
changed_reading.after: Recognize and answer from within a mercy that is already rescuing you from surrounding peril, but only for a limited interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the exact when-it-is-said-to-them frame but commands expenditure from apportioned provision and exposes refusal to feed. Later, what divine hands made becomes human property, while final dominion remains in the divine hand. The focus's hand-field can therefore be a nested sphere of entrusted control whose protection requires circulation, not hoarding.

activation_trace.role: The possessing hand supplies the domain over which the addressees can exercise disposal.
The beneficent hand makes generosity a latent use of present possession.
Uttered speech reproduces the focus's passive command frame and records the refusal that follows.
The going-out of wealth supplies the concrete action by which held provision circulates.
An apportioned gift recasts possession as received provision rather than autonomous ownership.
Feeding another supplies the social destination of expenditure and the refused form of care.
Work attributed to divine hands places human holdings downstream of prior divine production.
Ownership and disposal name the real but derivative control granted to the recipients.
The possessing hand relocates every lesser possession inside final divine control.
Sovereign dominion supplies the higher ownership within which human stewardship operates.

structural_cues: 36:45 and 36:47 share وإذا قيل لهم followed by an imperative.
36:71 says the addressees own what divine hands made, and 36:83 closes with all dominion in His hand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the duplicated command frame, provision, expenditure, feeding, derivative ownership, and final dominion; I infer that the second command concretizes one social mode of the first. The live alternative is that the two commands are adjacent but independent admonitions.

changed_reading.before: Protect yourselves from what surrounds you.
changed_reading.after: Protect the moral use of what lies under your control by treating provision as entrusted and allowing mercy to move through it to others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bounded interval before the focus is followed by a questioned appointment, a single cry that seizes people mid-dispute, and inability either to transmit a final charge or return to family. Front and behind become an asymmetric deadline: an event approaches from ahead while return to unfinished relations behind is about to close.

activation_trace.role: An interval occurring during a condition permits the spatial phrase to carry temporal pressure.
What is ahead supplies the approaching side of the deadline.
What is behind supplies the place and relations to which return will fail.
A bounded time supplies the response window immediately preceding the command.
A promise fixed to a time supplies the approaching event whose timing is challenged.
A terrifying cry supplies the abrupt arrival that ends deliberation.
Seizure and capture supply the event's irreversible grip while people are occupied.
A charge meant to remain connected to another supplies the unfinished transmission.
The near group of belonging supplies the relational world left behind.
Return to a former place supplies the movement that the sudden event makes impossible.

structural_cues: 36:44 grants continuation only إلى حين, while 36:48 asks when the promise will occur.
36:49-50 moves directly from seizure during dispute to failed testament and failed return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a limited term, appointed promise, abrupt seizure, and failed return; I infer that the focus's front and behind organize this vanishing response interval. A live alternative is a purely spatial merism with urgency supplied independently by the later sequence.

changed_reading.before: The command surveys two static zones of danger.
changed_reading.after: The command marks a vanishing interval between what is about to seize you and the people or obligations to which you will no longer be able to return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pair erases sight while people race for the path, then fixes them so they can neither proceed nor return. The focus command can therefore protect a capacity rather than a territory: the still-open ability to see, orient, move forward, and turn back before those directions close.

activation_trace.role: Putting the self into protection supplies preventive care for the faculty of response.
The forward field supplies one still-available direction of movement.
The rearward field supplies the complementary direction of return.
Loss of light and sight supplies the threatened collapse of orientation.
Racing ahead supplies forward motion attempted after sight is erased.
The straight path supplies the route that cannot be found without perception.
Literal seeing supplies the questioned faculty needed to navigate the path.
Passing onward supplies the forward capacity removed by fixation.
Returning to a former position supplies the rearward capacity removed at the same time.

structural_cues: 36:66 combines erased eyes, racing toward the path, and the question of how sight remains possible.
36:67 balances inability to proceed with inability to return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight-loss, path-racing, fixation, failed advance, and failed return; I infer that the focus protects the reversible capacity to orient before it closes. The live alternative is that these later disabilities are consequences rather than the command's implied object.

changed_reading.before: Danger consists of objects situated ahead and behind.
changed_reading.after: Danger includes losing the capacity to read either direction at all; the command protects the present possibility of seeing, proceeding, and returning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links separated speech events and the focus leaves the speaker unstated. It remains anchored in قيل and ترحمون, reinforced by admission-speech, a peace-saying from a merciful Lord, and speech followed by coming-to-be. Render it as a possible speech-act pattern, not as an identification of every speaker or a claim that the command forces compliance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive قيل delivers the command whose stated horizon is ترحمون.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the possibility that delivery of the warning is itself an intervention.
Merciful beneficence supplies the quality potentially enacted by giving the warning.
Uttered speech includes a passive admission command, supplying a saying that changes the hearer's state.
Freedom from harm supplies the content carried by the later saying.
Uttered speech explicitly carries peace, making saying and protection converge.
Merciful beneficence identifies the quality of the source from whom the peace-saying comes.
Uttered saying immediately precedes coming-to-be, supplying the strongest speech-efficacy analogy in the packet.

changed_reading.before: The saying merely reports what the addressees must do to receive future mercy.
changed_reading.after: The arrival of the warning may itself be a mercy-bearing act that opens protection and response before the addressees accept or refuse it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is highly branch-distant: it combines the womb sense of رحم, a non-dominant protective-buttress mapping for أيدي, and pregnancy or vessel images elsewhere. It remains anchored in the focus roots and a visible carry-vessel-origin-recreation chain. Render it only as a material analogy for containing mercy, never as a lexical translation equating the verse, the ship, or the Quran with a womb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: اتقوا supplies protective containment, the split أيدي inventory supplies a guarding buttress, and رحم supplies a womb as well as mercy.

activation_trace.role: A barrier that wards off harm supplies the outer logic of containment.
The form-distant guarding buttress supplies a structural wall around the vulnerable interior.
The womb as a house of growth supplies the inner material analogy for mercy.
A form-distant womb gathering a pregnancy supplies an early image of collected life.
Concealed bearing and fruit supply a gestational analogue within the explicit act of carrying descendants.
The waterborne vessel supplies a containing body that carries vulnerable life through exposure.
The womb branch overlays the explicit mercy exception with a contained-life image.
Generative fluid from drop to larger water supplies the fragile origin of the carried human life.
Conception and emerging pregnancy supply a form-distant bridge from first origin to renewed creation.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is affective beneficence granted after protective obedience.
changed_reading.after: Mercy may also be pictured as a gestational vessel that contains fragile life across origin, exposure, and renewed creation, with the command calling for refuge within that protection.

strongest_changes: The exact phrase in 36:9 reverses the shield model: front and rear barriers can become a sealed field that destroys sight, and 36:46 adds active aversion.
The forward deed and trailing trace in 36:12, followed by hand-work and hand-testimony, turn front and behind into an accountable causal field.
The carry-drown-no-rescue-except-mercy sequence in 36:41-44 makes mercy an already operative but time-bounded rescue.
The duplicated command frame in 36:47 and the later hierarchy of hands and ownership make present holdings a domain of stewardship and feeding.
The sudden no-return sequence and the later inability to proceed or return turn the spatial pair into a closing interval of response.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet placed an exact obstructed version of the focus coordinates before the ayah, a mercy-as-rescue sequence immediately beside it, and later hand, path, ownership, and speech scenes that preserved several competing mechanisms instead of collapsing them.
remaining_uncertainties: The barriers of 36:9 may be a direct implied object of the focus command or only a strong analogy for comprehensive danger.
Spatial, temporal, causal, and stewardship readings of front and behind remain live together; the packet does not force one referent.
The mercy-bearing speech and gestational vessel models are branch-driven outliers and should not be rendered as lexical equivalences.
